definitions: A commune in the Yonne department in Bourgogne-Franche-Comté in north-central France.
A district in Paris, France, known for its intellectual and artistic history.
A type of liqueur, typically elderflower-flavored.
examples: He visited Saint-Germain during his trip to France.
The café culture of Saint-Germain is legendary.
She ordered a cocktail with Saint-Germain.
